title: Daga binciken bincike zuwa tabbataccen gyara
course_title: Inganta Injin Bincike (SEO): Ƙwararrun Ƙwararru da Ayyukan Abokin Ciniki

say: Daga binciken bincike zuwa tabbataccen gyara.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module biyu na ƙwararrun kwas ɗin SEO.
Masu son son baiwa abokin ciniki dogon jerin duk abin da bai cika ba. Masu sana'a suna ba da ɗan gajeren tsari, tsari wanda aka ba da umarni inda abubuwa na farko suka fi mahimmanci.

Tabbatar da ko da gaske canji yayi aiki

say: Binciken yana bayyana matsala. Tikitin yana gaya wa mutum ɗaya ainihin abin da zai yi. Yana iya zama a cikin rukunin WhatsApp ko takardar da aka raba.

Tikitin Ada na shafukan yawon shakatawa 38 mai taken iri ɗaya ya haɗa da duk sabbin lakabi 38, wacce ta rubuta. Tikiti masu banƙyama kamar haɓaka lakabi sune mafi yawan dalilin da yasa shawarar SEO ba ta taɓa yin hakan ba.

say: Shawarwari ba sakamako bane. Da farko, buɗe tushen shafin kuma tabbatar da canjin. Idan bai nuna ba, tambayi mai haɓakawa ya share cache kafin ku kira shi ya kasa.

panel.heading: Dubawa uku cewa gyara yana raye

cards.d: Duba tushe akan shafuka biyu ko uku da abin ya shafa, akan waya kuma, kuma tabbatar da ainihin canjin.
Ja jiki tare da saituna iri ɗaya da tushen tushen ku kuma kwatanta kirga.
Gwada URL kai tsaye a cikin Binciken URL, sannan danna Tabbatar da gyara don al'amuran fiddawa.

say: Don tunawa. Bambance-bambance ta hanyar abin da ke da mahimmanci ga kasuwancin. Gyara masu blockers da farko, sannan saka sauran. Rubuta tikiti tare da fayyace ma'aunin karɓa. Tabbatar da kowane gyara hanyoyi uku. Kuma auna ma'auni daidai, ƙungiyar kwatanta da tarihin canjin kwanan wata.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Bambance-bambance ta mahimmancin kasuwanci, ba ɗanyen kirga ba
Critical blockers farko, sa'an nan ya ci sauran
Tikiti sun bayyana halin yanzu, buƙata da karɓa
Tabbatar da kowane gyara hanyoyi uku
Matsakaicin lokaci, rukunin kwatance, gunkin canji

say: Yanzu gudanar da ƙaramin rajistan shiga kan rukunin yanar gizon da zaku iya shiga, ƙididdige abubuwan bincikenku, rubuta cikakken tikiti ɗaya, sannan fara log ɗin canjin ku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Bincika shafuka biyu kuma jera kowane dalili mai ƙididdigewa
Saka bincike biyar kuma rubuta cikakken tikiti daya
Fara rajistan canji tare da ginshiƙai bakwai
Auna canji ɗaya bayan kwanaki 28
